newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MAY 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE MAY 20.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Socialist party leader Lionel Jospin says in an interview there is no reason why he should feel committed to the "stability pact" on deficit control after the launch of European monetary union. He also says France Telecom workers would be consulted over a privatisation if the left-wing coalition won the upcoming parliamentary election.
-- GEC Alsthom may be interested in buying shipyard Leroux et Lotz.
-- Train drivers strike at railway operator SNCF expected to end today.
-- La Redoute mail-order group buys 75 percent of Sweden-based Ellos.
